routes.label: registration at 15: online, then biometrics at school or the ICA Services Centre; collect from the next working day
re-registration at 30 and at 55: online, processed within 7 working days

note: For Singapore citizens; a permanent resident pays S$50 (not modelled here). The card has no term in years: it must be registered at 15 (before the 16th birthday) and re-registered at 30 and again at 55, so its validity is left null and the player is told. Registration's time is the ICA's: after the biometrics enrolment the card can be collected from the next working day; re-registration is processed within seven working days.

sources.title: Immigration & Checkpoints Authority, Register Identity Card for 15-year-olds
sources.said: The Identity Card (IC) is a compulsory document that Singapore citizens and permanent residents must register when they reach the age of 15 ... S$10 for Singapore citizens S$50 for Singapore permanent residents. ... Upon completion of enrolment of biometrics, the IC applicant can make an appointment the next working day to collect his/her IC at the designated post offices.

sources.title: Immigration & Checkpoints Authority, Re-Register Identity Card for 30/55-year-olds
sources.said: must re-register for when they reach the age of 30 (before their 31st birthday), and again when they reach the age of 55 (before their 56th birthday) ... S$10 for Singapore citizens ... We will process your application within seven working days.
